issues.problem: EN adds that Lord Xinling 'called on him' before offering the gift; ZH only says 公子要厚赠，他不肯受 (he wanted to make a handsome gift and Hou Ying refused), with no visit mentioned.
issues.suggestion: Drop 'called on him and' so EN reads: 'Lord Xinling wanted to make him a handsome gift, but he would not accept...' (or add the visit to ZH if intended).

issues.problem: The quoted line 顧未有路耳 (she had no avenue/way to do so) is rendered in EN as 'she had no way to repay him,' shifting the sense from 'no means of serving him' to 'no way of repaying him.'
issues.suggestion: Render as: only 'she had no way to do so' (or 'no means of serving him yet').

overall: The English edition faithfully carries all facts, figures, quotations and hedges of the Chinese original, with only two trivial paraphrasing slips noted and no missing or truncated content.
